text: Thus, even while the Lord of the Universe shines within one's own self, that manifestation and the awareness of His qualities do not bring about a state of fullness during times of separation. However, when an awareness of the supremacy of the Supreme Lord—characterized by omniscience, omnipotence, and other such attributes—arises through the words of the Guru and other means, then at that very moment, the attainment of complete selfhood occurs.
